evidence.text: This problem is compounded by the `fulfillDeposits()` mechanism which first adds new shares to `totalSupply` and then allocates them to users via `executeDeposit()`. This two-step process creates a permanent accounting imbalance.

This violates the fundamental ERC20 standard `totalSupply ≠ sum of all balances`. Phantom shares “steal” a significant proportion of the vault’s value, resulting in users losing 66% of their true value. Share prices are calculated using an inflated `totalSupply` which results in users getting far less than they should.

links.reported_relation: Phantom bootstrap shares make totalSupply exceed the sum of balances, and share prices computed from the inflated totalSupply let phantom shares capture vault value.
